translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Aaen Jesus Menaw Sefaaen
Mwirin raaenin Sabbath, nge Maria Magdalene, Maria we inaen James iwe me Salome ra chuwaai neoningas, pwe repwe noa aepiti miniwe oanongaen Jesus.
Weni mmwaei raaenin Sunday, oatowe aenet epwene teeotae, ra noa reen paeyi we.

Wooan aar faaeraeg noa, ra kkepas fengaen nee fineer, “Iyo epwe peniy ngaenigirh fai we mesaen paeyi we?” (Egin faeregit fai we.) Nge renoa fannoai paeyi we, ra giuneei pwe fai we a faer mwagiut saengi aesemaen paeyi we.
Igiwe ra toonong noan paeyi we, ra weri erhai mwaaen anian emooat peig mwaaenen paeyi we, e memmengaag min pwerhepwerh, nge ra mesag reen.
A aengaeniir pwe, “Oawsoapw mesag. I giuneei pwe oaw giutta Jesus re Nazareth we re kurusuw noa. Esa nono igeei, a menaw sefaaen! Oaw pipiiy, igaan igiwe re oawnatiw ee.
Iwe oawnoa aengaeniir rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun me pwan Peter: ‘Iiy ina epwene gommw noa Galilee me mmwaemi; iginaan minne oawpwene noa weri me ee, taeppen rhag meeta we e aengaenigaemi.’ ”
Iwe ra toowow nge ra fattapw saengi paeyi we, noan aar mesag me riu. Nge rese aepesa ngaeni mwo nge erhai, pwe ra igin mesag.
Eew Soapwonoan Kkepas Mwamwaai we
Jesus a Pwae Ngaeni Maria Magdalene
[Mwirin aaen Jesus menaw sefaaen nee oatosoron raaenin Sunday we, egommwaen pwae ngaeni Maria Magdalene, iwe e oatowowuw fiusiuman aniu aenneew me reen.
Niewe a noa iwe a noa aengaeniir rhooawe rhinaan. Rhooawe re sessaeng reen aenneewaen nee tipeer;
nge igiwe ra rongorong pwe Jesus a menaw sefaaen pwe iiy a weri, nge rese niugiuniug ngaeni.
Jesus a Pwae Ngaeniir Riiurhai Rhoaniuwan
Mwirin minneei nge Jesus a pwaenoan pwan eew taeppen wegitaeg ngaeniir riiurhai rhooan kkayeo kkewe igiwe re faaeraeg ngaeni aepinoamw we.
Ra sefaaen nge ra aengaeniir ikkiwe aaemweoi, nge iir rese niugiuniug reer.
Jesus a Pwae Ngaeniir Rhooawe Seig me Erhai
Oarosan noa nge Jesus a pwae ngaeniir rhooawe seig me erhai igiwe iir re mwongo. A songetiir, pwe esooar aar niugiuniug, ra pwan tipoarorh, pwe rese niugiur rhooawe ra weri pwe Jesus a menaw sefaaen.
Iwe a aengaeniir pwe, “Oawnoa wooan oanongaen faniuw oawpwe noa fenaiuw Kkepas Mwamwaai een ngaeniir oanongeer aeremas.
Iyo e niugiuniug nge a paptismus nge epwe menaw, nge iyo ese niugiuniug nge epwe aegaeregaer.
Rhooakka re niugiuniug repwe fang maemaeweer pwe repwe feeori manaman: repwe asiiur aniu aenneew faaen itaei; nge repwe kkepesaen noa eew me eew faniuw,
ngaere repwe pweipwog sowufaeng aere iun pwoisiun, nge resoapw woas; nge repwe iseni tae paiiur wooar rhooa semwaai nge repwe cchipw tae.”
Jesus a Ittae Naaeng
Mwirin aaen Soamwoon Jesus kkepas ngaeniir, a ittae naaeng a ittae mooat peig mwaaenen Deus.
Rhooan kkayeo kkewe ra noa fenai wooan oanongaen pwiuneoi, nge Soamwoon e engaang neeiir nge e pwaeri noa aar fenai pwe ennet reen oanongaen manaman kkewe ra feeori.]

Pwan Eew Aigiugiun Kkepas Mwamwaai we 9a [Rhooapwut kkewe ra noa reen Peter me rhooawe rhinan ra noa fioangei ngaeniir oanongaen meeta kkewe re rongorong. 10a Mwirin minneei nge Jesus wooan oanongan a fang wow rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun pwe repwe noa fenai fetaeneei saengi eotiw toori netow kkepas mwamwaai we kkepesaen menaw na esooar ssiaaenin.]
